name: 01-mumbai-wallet-mascot
title: Mumbai wallet mascot
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: ONE premium illustrated collectible sticker for Namera, for Devcon Mumbai 2026.
Style direction: designer-made Ethereum hackathon merchandise in the spirit of the user's ETHGlobal Tokyo and ETHIndia sticker references: bold editorial vector-style cartoons, crisp confident dark ink contours, interlocking color-block shapes, playful local cultural detail, cleverly patterned surfaces, flat graphic composition and a strong die-cut silhouette. NOT painterly anime, NOT cinematic scenery, NOT 3D rendering, NOT generic clipart. Sophisticated illustration with medium-weight consistent outlines and some fine internal linework. Palette strictly warm cream #FFF2D8, indigo #5E6AD2, burnt orange #ED784A, golden saffron #F3BC48, dark navy #25263B. Use bright warm colors as restrained details, indigo and cream dominant. High craftsmanship, meaningful details, no random decorations. Every part completely visible, a tidy compact composition occupying 78% of a square canvas with a generous transparent margin. Genuine transparent background. No shadow outside the illustration, no printed white border (added later), no rectangle enclosing the whole canvas. Output largest possible square image, crisp print quality.
Absolutely NO text, letters, words, numerals, logos or watermark. No Ethereum or ETHGlobal branding; Namera lettering will be added accurately as vectors.
Scene: An iconic full-body agent-wallet mascot with an indigo wallet body, cream retro screen-like face with two simple eyes and a small smile, stout orange sneakers, one hand holding a cutting-chai glass, other hand showing a little rectangular permission card with three simple tick marks. A patterned orange bandana is wrapped at its neck, Mumbai streetwear personality. Small brass-like clasp and carefully drawn wallet edge stitching. Posing with relaxed confidence, slightly asymmetrical silhouette, absolutely no landscape or scenery. The character should feel like a polished collectible mascot in the Tokyo retro-computer character tradition, not an illustration of a real leather wallet.
